postgres-mcp-skill v1.0.0 changelog

- Initial release of the PostgreSQL database management and optimization assistant.
- Supports health checks, index optimization, query plan analysis, schema queries, and SQL execution via postgres-mcp tools.
- Includes mandatory pre-check to ensure postgres-mcp MCP tools are available before any operation.
- Implements intent recognition and routing for common PostgreSQL tasks.
- Enforces safety constraints: confirmation required for write operations, read-only mode support, and performance protection for long-running queries.
